Remittance image/EOP from BCBS PPO dated 12/02/2025 shows ICN BCBS-2025-54384, DOS 04/10/2025 CPT 29881 billed $5,940, paid $0, contractual adj $540, denied balance $5,400 with CARC CO-29 and RARC N657; patient responsibility $0. Claim history shows only original submission on 10/05/2025 to Change Healthcare with clearinghouse acknowledgment ACK-CLH-20251005-7892 and payer response/denial on 12/01/2025. Days from service date 04/10/2025 to initial submission 10/05/2025 = 178 days, which supports timely filing (within a 180-day filing window) and rebuts CO-29. Patient inquiry confirms active BCBS PPO coverage for member ID BCBS567890123 for Elena Santos, DOB 06/15/1977, with no self-pay responsibility. Do not write off based on current evidence; route for appeal using the clearinghouse ack/timely submission proof and active coverage details. Note: system shows appeal deadline 01/15/2026 was already past as of 02/25/2026, so appeals team should evaluate late-appeal options/escalation, but denial itself has a factual basis for appeal.
